methods.name: Multi-level Intertemporal Attention-guided Network (MIANet)
methods.summary: MIANet is an encoder-decoder network that uses MobileNetV2 as an encoder. It incorporates an Intertemporal Fusion Attention Unit (IFAU) for early feature interaction, a Change Location and Recognition Module (CLRM) with dilated convolutions and Coordinate Attention Mechanism (CAM) for multi-scale change detection, and a Supervised Attention Module (SAM) for feature aggregation.
methods.source: Shuo Liu, Qinyu Zhang, Yuhang Zhang, Xiaochen Niu, Wuxia Zhang, and Fei Xie

availability.author_statement: "No new data were created in this manuscript."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the MIANet method is not available.
